ext.tunnel.title: Access from the internet
ext.tunnel.subtitle: Players join through a tunnel, no port forwarding on your router
ext.tunnel.enableHint: Opens when the server starts and closes when it stops
ext.tunnel.tokenSet: Saved, leave empty to keep it
ext.tunnel.expires: The free plan closes the tunnel in {min} min, it reopens with a new address
ext.tunnel.status.waiting: Waiting for the server to start
ext.tunnel.provider.minekube.hint: Free, address without a port. Java only
ext.tunnel.provider.pinggy.hint: Free for an hour at a time, Pro keeps the address. Java only
ext.tunnel.provider.frp.hint: Your VPS with frps, Java and Bedrock
ext.tunnel.minekube.name: Address name
ext.tunnel.minekube.nameHint: 3-32 characters: a-z, 0-9 and -. The first server to take a name keeps it
ext.tunnel.minekube.warningTitle: The server has to run in offline mode
ext.tunnel.minekube.warning: Set online-mode=false in the server settings, Minekube checks accounts itself. Players get new UUIDs, so on a server that ran in online mode their inventories and progress start over. Anyone who can reach the server port directly, for example from your local network, can join under any name
ext.tunnel.pinggy.tokenHint: Optional. Without it the address changes every hour
ext.tunnel.pinggy.note: Needs the ssh program on the panel host
ext.tunnel.frp.remoteUdpPortHint: 0 if you don't need Bedrock. Needs a Bedrock or Geyser port on the server
ext.tunnel.frp.note: frps on your server needs these ports open and the same token
ext.tunnel.error.invalid.minekube.name: Enter an address name: 3-32 characters, a-z, 0-9 and -
ext.tunnel.error.invalid.frp.serverPort: The frp server port must be 1-65535
ext.tunnel.error.invalid.frp.remoteUdpPo: The Bedrock port must be 1-65535 or 0
ext.tunnel.error.invalid.noJavaPort: This server has no Java port to share
ext.tunnel.error.minekube.nameTaken: This name belongs to someone else, pick another one
ext.tunnel.error.pinggy.auth: Pinggy didn't accept the connection, check the token
ext.tunnel.error.frp.auth: The frp server didn't accept the token
ext.tunnel.error.frp.portTaken: The port on the frp server is taken or not allowed
ext.tunnel.error.network: Can't reach the tunnel service, retrying
ext.tunnel.error.missing.ssh: ssh is not installed on the panel host
ext.tunnel.error.invalid.sshKey: Couldn't create an ssh key, check that ssh is installed on the panel host
